title: 第7章 这个女配有点惨（7）
slug: 恶毒女配又在作死发疯虐哭主角
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傅司恒的脚步顿住了。

“故意杀人？”

“对啊，”

时姝的声音压低了，像是在替他遮掩，“我知道你可能不信，但我刚刚去见张阿姨了，她哭得上气不接下气。

伤心的很。

她说沈璎在车里用打火机威胁她，还用碎玻璃划伤了她的脸……现在反过来告张阿姨故意杀人。

她也太过分了。

之前她是不是一直这么仗着有你在，就肆意陷害别人啊？

还是和当初高中那样，一点小矛盾就说别人霸凌她，用命陷害别人？

现在已经把张阿姨在里头关了七天了，她还不满足吗？”

“我是无所谓，大不了出国嘛！

可张阿姨怎么说也是她妈啊，就算有不对的地方，母女之间至于闹成这样吗？”

傅司恒沉默了几秒，声音沉下来：“她真的把张澜告了？”

“是啊。

司恒，你能不能劝劝沈璎？她这样搞自己的亲妈，传出去对她自己的名声也不好啊。

真的太任性了。

其实如果是因为我的关系，她针对张阿姨的话，我可以出国不再回来的。

我就是心疼一个做妈妈的，十月怀胎生下来的孩子，这样对待自己……太让人心寒了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fu Siheng's footsteps paused.

"Intentional murder?"

"Yes,"

Shi Shu's voice was lowered, as if she was covering for him, "I know you may not believe it, but I just went to see Aunt Zhang and she was crying so hard that she was out of breath.

Very sad.

She said that Shen Ying threatened her with a lighter in the car and scratched her face with broken glass... Now she is suing Aunt Zhang for intentional homicide.

She also went too far.

Did she always wantonly frame others just because you were there?

Or is it like she did in high school, where she would accuse others of bullying her and try to frame others for the slightest conflict?

Aunt Zhang has been locked up inside for seven days now. Isn't she still satisfied?"

"I don't care, the worst thing I can do is go abroad!

But Aunt Zhang is still her mother after all. Even if there is something wrong, is there such a quarrel between mother and daughter?"

Fu Siheng was silent for a few seconds, and then his voice deepened: "Did she really sue Zhang Lan?"

"Yeah.

Si Heng, can you give Shen Ying some advice?It would not be good for her own reputation if word spread about her doing this to her biological mother.

It's really too willful.

In fact, if she targeted Aunt Zhang because of my relationship, I could go abroad and never come back.

I just feel sorry for a mother who gave birth to a child in ten months of pregnancy. Treating herself like this... is so chilling.
